=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml
  Line or code reference: lines 40-72 (derive_check_name_key job definition + triage job needs dependency)
  Problem: The triage job declares `needs: derive_check_name_key` and references `${{ needs.derive_check_name_key.outputs.check_name_key }}` in its concurrency group. Both jobs carry identical `if:` conditions, so the gate should always evaluate the same way. However, if the derive job fails at runtime (runner crash, OOM, infra glitch) the triage job is skipped by GitHub Actions even though its own `if:` evaluates to true. There is no fallback — no `if: always()` on the triage job, and no inline fallback for the concurrency key.
  Why it fails at runtime: A transient runner failure on the trivial key-derivation job silently drops the entire triage for that check-run completion event. The check_run.completed event fires once per unique check-run ID, so that specific event is lost. The system self-heals on the next push or re-run (which creates a new check-run ID), but one event is lost.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Requirement: The PR introduces four new files under tracked inventory surfaces — `prompts/mode-check-failure-triage.txt` (Phase prompts), `.github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml` (Workflows), `.github/workflows/internal-check-failure-triage.yml` (Workflows), and `scripts/check_failure_triage.sh` (Scripts). The inventory parity contract enforced by `tests/inventory_parity.py` requires every file matching these tracked globs to have a row in `docs/INVENTORY.md`. This is a standing repo convention, not a new requirement from this PR.
  Expected change site: `docs/INVENTORY.md` — add entries in the alphabetically sorted "Phase prompts", "Workflows", and "Scripts" sections.
  Evidence of absence: The CI lint check on head SHA `1fb0710` proves the gap: `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/inventory_parity.py` exits 1 with seven FAIL lines naming the four missing entries plus three secondary cross-reference failures (`README.md:954`, `agents.md:50`, `agents.md:51`). Running `grep -n 'check_failure_triage\|mode-check-failure-triage' docs/INVENTORY.md` returns zero matches. None of the five autofix rounds in this PR modified INVENTORY.md.
